newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Republic Industries Inc Q2 net rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Republic Industries Inc Q2 net rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q2 EPS rose 132 percent while revenues rose 59 percent.
Operating income, before restructuring and non-recurring expenses for the three and six months ended June 30, 1997, increased to $103.3 million and $148.0 million.
Q2 1997 includes a $102.3 million pre-tax gain from sale of 15 million shares of ADT Limited common stock.

Q2 1997 also includes $94.1 million pre-tax provision related to the integration of its automotive rental companies. The provision includes costs related to fleet consolidation, duplicate facilities, redundant systems and other non-recurring expenses.
The company did not specify what, if any, impact the items had on net income or earnings per share.
